features.label: FEATURES
features.title: Much more than a GitHub summary.
features.description: The goal is to transform an entire repository into an interface where you can actually interact with and understand the project.

architecture.title: Architecture
architecture.description: Identify the project's structure and organization.

technologies.title: Technologies
technologies.description: Discover the programming language being used.

code.title: Code
code.description: Ask questions about specific files and code snippets.

aiRag.title: AI + RAG
aiRag.description: Get answers using the repository's own content.

howItWorks.label: HOW IT WORKS
howItWorks.title: From URL to a complete analysis.
howItWorks.description: The system will process the repository and use AI to transform the code into useful information.

repository.title: 01 — Enter the repository
repository.description: Paste the public URL of any GitHub repository you want to analyze.

analysis.title: 02 — AI analyzes the code
analysis.description: The system will process the project's files, structure, dependencies, and relevant content.

results.title: 03 — Explore the results
results.description: You will be able to chat with the AI about the repository and get answers based on the code itself.
